title: JUST RIGHT — alphanumeric field right-justified on MOVE; left-padded with spaces
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. RIGHT-JUSTIFY.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
      *> WS-CODE has JUSTIFIED RIGHT (or JUST RIGHT). MOVE 'AB' to
      *> it produces '   AB' (3 leading spaces, 2 trailing chars).
      *> Default alphanumeric is LEFT-justified -> 'AB   '. The
      *> Java port has to mirror the justification explicitly.
       01  WS-CODE    PIC X(5) JUST RIGHT.
       01  WS-DEFAULT PIC X(5).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE "AB" TO WS-CODE.
           MOVE "AB" TO WS-DEFAULT.
           STOP RUN.
notes: JUST RIGHT is common in customer-key fields where the key is right-aligned in a 10-char slot. A naive port that uses padEnd/padRight loses the alignment. Surface the explicit justification.
